structured_summary: The robot announces a package delivery via speech. The user must acknowledge the delivery (by speech or head nod) within 8 seconds of the announcement. Upon receiving the acknowledgment, the robot must give a final confirmation of delivery via speech within 1 second.

obligations.source_sentence: The robot should announce the delivery via speech.
The user is expected to acknowledge the delivery (e.g., via speech or a head nod) within 8 seconds of the announcement.
Once the acknowledgment is received, the robot must provide a final confirmation of delivery via speech within 1 second.

missing_details: Exact start point for the 8‑second and 1‑second deadlines (e.g., end of announcement vs. start)
Criteria for detecting a valid head‑nod acknowledgment
What happens if the user fails to acknowledge within 8 seconds (failure handling, retries, abort)
What happens if the robot fails to give final confirmation within 1 second
Any required success criteria for package delivery beyond the communication exchange
Environmental noise or interference considerations that could affect speech recognition
potential_ambiguities: Whether the 8‑second window begins at the start or end of the robot's announcement
Whether the 1‑second window begins at the moment the acknowledgment is detected or after it is completed
Whether a head nod must be a specific gesture or any head movement counts as acknowledgment
Whether the robot should repeat the announcement if no acknowledgment is received
Whether the final confirmation must be identical to the announcement or can be a different phrase
